Canvas bell tent with open door and cosy interior in a sunlit tropical garden (first candidate, official site). Alternative on the same site: 1665046558tent-3.png (row of tents).
White Sino-Portuguese arcaded facade of the hotel (no. 26), with one guest posing at the entrance (first candidate). The other slideshow images are interiors and the small pool.

The hotel's hanging 'The Memory at On On hotel, Phuket Old Town' signboards on Phang Nga Road, with the white colonial Kasikorn Bank building filling most of the frame. Official site has only a grainy sepia archive photo, banners with dark text overlays, and a 359px modern facade thumbnail.

results.credit: Slleong (area photo: Thalang Road, Old Phuket Town)
results.note: AREA PHOTO, not the hotel itself: sunny Thalang Road shophouse streetscape (the continuation of Krabi Road; Shunli is at 56 Krabi Rd). No official website; the Facebook page's only public image is the red SHUNLI HOSTEL sign (803x793), which reads as a logo with a phone number in a 16:9 crop. Nothing on Commons. Candidate 1 rejected: the corner house carries another guesthouse's sign. Candidate 2 is overcast.

Beachfront pool with a large thatched sala and loungers, sea and mountains behind (official homepage gallery). Candidate 1942.jpg (white cottages in a garden) also passed but is less representative. The og-images aerial makes the resort tiny, and the Commons Ban Tai photo is overcast.

AREA PHOTO, not the hostel itself: Ban Tai Beach at sunset with palms (hostel is about 900 m inland). No official website or social page found and nothing on Commons. Booking.com and Agoda block scraping, and the Hostelworld listing (312348) now returns 404, so the hostel may be delisted or closed; worth re-checking. Candidate Ban_Tai_Beach_Ko_Pha_Ngan.jpg rejected as dull and overcast.

Guests on pink and yellow loungers at the pool terrace in front of the hostel's lilac building. It is the og:image of the official Koh Phangan beachfront hostel page, the same photo appears in the property's Hostelworld gallery, and the lilac building is visible from the entrance. Candidate Cloudbeds 10-bed dorm photo also passed. Rejected an official 'baan tai pic 6' pool photo whose pool does not match the property's other photos.
